author: New China TV
description: Fourteen people have been confirmed dead following a powerful earthquake that struck Kumamoto Prefecture, southwestern Japan, on Tuesday. The quake caused severe damage at a local paper plant, causing five deaths while two were injured and four others remained missing, local media reported Wednesday. #Japan #earthquake
title: On-site | 5 dead, 4 missing after smokestack collapses at quake-hit paper plant in SW Japan

author: New China TV
description:
From July 16 to 29, the 2026 #APEC Digital Weeks is being held in Chengdu, the capital of southwest China's Sichuan Province, where delegates from APEC economies explore the future of artificial intelligence (AI) and digital technology.
Chengdu isn't just a host. The city is a real-world AI lab. Backed by robust computing power, robots here handle deliveries, guide tourists, assist in surgeries ... AI is woven into everyday life.
As APEC champions inclusive AI development, Chengdu is showing the world what it really means to empower communities and industries with technology.
title: Why Chengdu? How AI becoming part of everyday life

author: New China TV
description: A Venezuelan vlogger traveled to southwest China's Guizhou Province to explore FAST, the world's largest single-dish radio telescope. Beyond the breathtaking "China's Sky Eye," he also discovered how the landmark science project has helped transform a once-remote village into an astronomy-themed town, creating new opportunities through science education and tourism. #GLOBALink
title: Venezuelan vlogger explores FAST, rural revitalization in China's Guizhou

description: China on Wednesday expressed strong dissatisfaction and firm opposition after the U.S. Department of Defense placed some Chinese research institutions on a sanctions list, the Ministry of Commerce said. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China opposes U.S. move to sanction Chinese research institutions

author: New China TV
description: What does a movie night look like in rural China today? In a small town in east China's Anhui Province, a cinema showing the latest releases is drawing packed crowds, while creating local jobs and bringing new energy to the community.
title: Why is this rural cinema in China so popular

author: New China TV
description:
Imagine playing a game of chess without moving a single finger!
Using a China-developed implantable brain-computer interface (BCI), two people with spinal cord injuries in Shanghai and Nanchang--more than 800 kilometers apart--recently faced off in a game of Chinese chess using only their brain signals. One controlled a virtual chessboard with his mind, while the other used a brain-controlled robotic glove to move the real pieces.
title: China-developed BCI enables mind-controlled chess match

author: New China TV
description:
From ancient prayers for calm seas and Zheng He's voyages to today's regional dialogue and joint exercises, the South China Sea has long carried a shared hope for peace.
Watch Episode 2, "Sea of Peace," of the four-part micro-documentary and explore how history, cooperation and mutual trust help keep these waters open, connected and tranquil.
title: Surging Tides over the South China Sea: A Voyage to the Future (2)

author: New China TV
description:
For over a thousand years, one city has carried China's porcelain legacy.
Located along the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River, Jingdezhen is known as China's "Porcelain Capital." Here, ancient craftsmanship continues to thrive.
Among its masterpieces, blue-and-white porcelain stands as a timeless classic.
Through delicate brushwork, layered coloring, and high-temperature firing, blue meets white -- creating an elegant beauty that has endured for centuries.
title: The timeless beauty of blue and white | Discovering Jingdezhen Porcelain

author: New China TV
description:
In Jingdezhen, some masterpieces aren't painted...
They're carved, with the tip of a needle.
This is Bahua Porcelain.
title: Art on the tip of a needle | Discovering Jingdezhen Porcelain

title: Work out at subway stations in S China's Shenzhen

author: New China TV
description:
A dog spotted a frightened kitten stranded on a wall above a stream in Guizhou, SW China. It barked nonstop until another dog - and nearby people - noticed the tiny cat in trouble. Thanks to the dog's persistence, the kitten was rescued and is now safe. 
#Guizhou #DogHero #KittenRescue #Heartwarming #AnimalFriends #China
title: Dog's urgent barks save trapped kitten

author: New China TV
description: What makes Jingdezhen China's "porcelain capital"? What gives its newly inscribed UNESCO World Heritage site its enduring appeal? Join Cheng Linyao, a young inheritor of Jingdezhen's traditional blue-and-white porcelain painting, as she shares a deeply personal journey through her hometown and the living heritage that continues to shape it today. #Jingdezhen #WorldHeritageSite #porcelain #CultureOfChina
title: Born of Porcelain: A Story from Jingdezhen

author: New China TV
description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping pointed out that Chinese modernization cannot be achieved without the inheritance and promotion of fine traditional culture, and that Tianjin is a city with distinct characteristics and charm. It is necessary to protect and make good use of historical and cultural blocks so that they can add to the beauty of this modern metropolis, said the president.
Tianjin's Ancient Culture Street is one of the city's earliest economic, cultural and trade hubs. Rich in history and tourism resources, the century-old block preserves the memories of local people and showcases the charm of Tianjin culture via generations of craftsmanship and innovation.  xhtxs.cn/bdUv
#LeadingChina #Tianjin
title: Discovering the timeless charm of Tianjin
